Most people skip the first step of getting what they want.

Kevin Trudeau says the biggest mistake with the law of attraction is missing step one. It is not talked about in the books or the classes.

His point is that you must find the pain first. Ask yourself whether you truly need what you want, or only wish you had it. Most people only wish.

What do you wish for that you do not truly need yet?
